content: PostgreSQL 迁移文件必须存放于 src/main/resources/db/migration，文件命名强制遵循 V{YYYYMMDDHHmmss}__{description}.sql 格式，且 Flyway 在 CI 流水线中开启了严格的校验和检测。
启动测试出现 PSQLException: ERROR: relation "orders" does not exist 时，是因为测试环境未自动触发 Flyway 迁移；需在 application-test.yml 中显式设置 spring.flyway.enabled=true 并指定 flyway.schemas=public。

本地调试 Kafka 消费：在测试类添加 @Testcontainers，声明 @Container static KafkaContainer kafka = new KafkaContainer(DockerImageName.parse("confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.6.0"))，并通过 @DynamicPropertySource 动态注入 spring.kafka.bootstrap-servers。
核心 Topic order-events-v1 在生产集群固定分配 12 个分区，消费组 ID 统一约束为 orderflow-processor-group，禁止业务方随意自建未经评审的 consumer group。

消费事件报错 ClassCastException: class java.lang.String cannot be cast to com.orderflow.event.OrderCreatedEvent，是因为 Kafka Consumer 缺失反序列化信任包；需在配置中声明 spring.kafka.consumer.properties.spring.json.trusted.packages: "com.orderflow.*"。
处理 DLQ 死信队列消息重试：运行 ./scripts/kafka/replay-dlq.sh --topic order-events-dlq --target order-events-v1 --max-records 100，并在 Grafana 的 Kafka Consumer 仪表盘观察是否有重复 offset commit 异常。
应用已启用 Java 21 虚拟线程支持（spring.threads.virtual.enabled: true），因此严禁在业务逻辑中直接缓存不受管理的 ThreadLocal，避免内存泄露与载体线程饥饿。
执行 ./gradlew compileJava 报错 java: Internal error in the mapping processor 时，是因为 MapStruct 与 Lombok 处理器加载顺序错误；需在 build.gradle 中保证 lombok-mapstruct-binding 声明在 mapstruct-processor 之前。
Kubernetes 部署清单维护在独立的 GitOps 仓库 infra-gitops/apps/orderflow/overlays/prod，禁止通过 kubectl 绕过 Argo CD 直接修改线上 Workload。
检查 Argo CD 同步失败排查步骤：首先执行 argocd app get orderflow-prod 查看同步差异，若处于 Degraded，运行 kubectl describe application orderflow-prod -n argocd 获取具体的 SyncHook 失败日志。
订单拓展信息采用 PostgreSQL JSONB 存储，对应 JPA 实体属性需标注 @JdbcTypeCode(SqlTypes.JSON) 并引入 hibernate-core 6.x 官方 JSON 支持，不使用废弃的 Hypersistence 类型定义。

高并发库存扣减抛出 ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException: Batch update returned unexpected row count from update [0] 时，需在 OrderProcessingService.submitOrder 方法上添加 @Retryable(retryFor = OptimisticLockException.class, maxAttempts = 3, backoff = @Backoff(delay = 100))。
安全更新订单表结构规范：先创建包含 DEFAULT NULL 列或带并发安全索引的 Flyway 迁移脚本（如 CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_status），并在本地运行 ./gradlew flywayValidate 校验无误后再提交 PR。
K8s 探针统一挂载至独立管理端口：Liveness 探针路径为 http://:8081/actuator/health/liveness，Readiness 探针为 http://:8081/actuator/health/readiness，management.server.port 固定为 8081。
线上 Pod 触发 exit code 137 (OOMKilled) 崩溃，原因在于 JVM 未识别容器 cgroup v2 限制；必须在 Dockerfile 中设置环境变量 JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0 -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError"。
跨服务的逆向退款流程基于 Saga 编排，补偿事务必须通过发送订单取消补偿事件至 Kafka topic order-compensation-events-v1 完成异步解耦。
更新 Swagger/OpenAPI 离线契约文件：执行 ./gradlew generateOpenApiDocs，该任务会在 build/api-spec/openapi.json 生成最新定义，随后使用 ./scripts/sync-api-docs.sh 推送给前端团队网关仓库。
提交代码被 Git hook 拒绝并提示 Format violations found in 4 files，需在终端执行 ./gradlew spotlessApply 自动格式化 Java 源码后再重新发起 git commit。
生产数据库与 Kafka 的密码凭证通过 External Secrets Operator (ESO) 从 HashiCorp Vault 动态注入，不得在 kustomization.yaml 中直接编写 SealedSecret 或 Base64 密文。
服务平滑下线调优：在 k8s deployment spec 中配置 terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 45，并在 application.yml 设置 server.shutdown: graceful 与 spring.kafka.consumer.properties.max.poll.interval.ms: 300000 避免消费再平衡震荡。
The Gradle wrapper version is locked at 8.7; never run tasks with system gradle, always invoke commands via ./gradlew to avoid unexpected toolchain resolution failures.

Encountered org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: ERROR: deadlock detected during concurrent batch updates; resolved by sorting items by order_item_id in ascending order before executing updates in OrderRepository.bulkUpdateStatus.

To check Kafka lag before starting a maintenance window, execute kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server kafka-broker:9092 --describe --group orderflow-processor-group and verify the LAG column across all 12 partitions is zero.
All state-changing methods in OrderService must be annotated with @Transactional(rollbackFor = Exception.class) to prevent uncommitted changes when handling checked business exceptions.

Build failed with error: Could not find or load main class after upgrading to Java 21; fixed by adding org.gradle.java.installations.auto-download=false and pointing org.gradle.java.home in gradle.properties to the JDK 21 installation.

To trigger an immediate out-of-band sync without UI access, run argocd app sync orderflow-prod --resource apps:Deployment:orderflow-service --prune=false and monitor with argocd app wait orderflow-prod --health.
Kafka producers in orderflow are configured with acks=all, enable.idempotence=true, and max.in.flight.requests.per.connection=5 to maintain absolute partition ordering without duplication.

Received com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.exc.InvalidDefinitionException: Java 8 date/time type java.time.Instant not supported; fixed by registering JavaTimeModule and setting spring.jackson.serialization.write-dates-as-timestamps=false.

To profile CPU utilization under high load on a staging pod, run kubectl exec -n orderflow-stage -it <pod-name> -- jcmd 1 JFR.start name=orderflow_load duration=60s filename=/tmp/orderflow.jfr, then download the profile via kubectl cp.
HikariCP pool sizing in src/main/resources/application-prod.yml is configured with maximum-pool-size: 20 and minimum-idle: 10 to prevent exhausting PostgreSQL max_connections across autoscaling pods.

Integration tests failed with RedisConnectionFailureException: Unable to connect to localhost:6379; fixed by attaching @Import(TestcontainersRedisConfiguration.class) to base integration test classes instead of expecting a local Redis daemon.

To protect a new internal endpoint: add the antMatcher in SecurityConfiguration.java with hasAuthority('SCOPE_order:admin'), annotate the controller method with @PreAuthorize, and write a verification test in SecurityIntegrationTest.java.
The production container image uses eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine as the base runtime and runs as unprivileged user orderflow (UID 10001) specified in docker/Dockerfile.multistage.

Encountered org.hibernate.MappingException: The increment size of the sequence is 50, but the sequence in database has increment of 1; resolved by updating @SequenceGenerator(name="order_seq", allocationSize=1) in Order.java to match PostgreSQL schema.

To roll back a faulty deployment in Argo CD: execute argocd app rollback orderflow-prod <revision-id>, verify deployment rollout using kubectl rollout status deployment/orderflow -n orderflow-prod, and lock auto-sync with argocd app set orderflow-prod --sync-policy none.
Distributed trace context propagation across Kafka headers uses W3C TraceContext format (traceparent) handled transparently via micrometer-tracing-bridge-otel and io.opentelemetry:opentelemetry-api.

Pod failed to start with CreateContainerConfigError due to secret "orderflow-db-secret" not found; resolved by adding the ExternalSecret definition to gitops/overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml and re-syncing Argo CD.

To execute only database-backed integration tests locally, run ./gradlew test --tests "*RepositoryIT" -Dspring.profiles.active=test-testcontainers --info, which starts ephemeral PostgreSQL containers using Ryuk.

Schema safety is strictly guarded: spring.flyway.validate-on-migrate: true is enabled in all profiles to immediately halt Spring context startup if any local migration checksum does not match deployed schema history.

Kafka producer threw org.apache.kafka.common.errors.RecordTooLargeException: The message is 1548576 bytes; resolved by adding spring.kafka.producer.properties.max.request.size=5242880 while aligning the broker limit max.message.bytes in Strimzi Kafka CR.
All global state hooks are typed and exported from `src/store/index.ts` as `useAppDispatch` and `useAppSelector`, bound to `RootState` and `AppDispatch`.

Detox iOS build failed with `xcodebuild: error: Entry point not found for target pixelcraft`; resolved by running `npx expo prebuild --platform ios --clean` before executing `detox build -c ios.sim.release`.
To run Android Detox E2E tests locally, run `npx detox build -c android.emu.debug` followed by `npx detox test -c android.emu.debug --record-videos failing --loglevel trace`.
Detox configuration is defined in `.detoxrc.js` and targets tests matching `e2e/**/*.e2e.ts` using Jest as the underlying runner.
Encountered `A non-serializable value was detected in an action` in `canvasSlice.ts`; fixed by adding `'canvas/exportFrame'` to `serializableCheck.ignoredActions` in `src/store/index.ts`.
Drawing coordinate calculations in `src/components/canvas/PixelGrid.tsx` must wrap results in `Math.floor()` to prevent floating-point blur on high-DPI iOS Retina displays.

Detox tests timed out with `DetoxSync :: Busy: Animating view`; resolved by wrapping the looped pulse animation in `src/components/canvas/SelectionBox.tsx` with `device.disableSynchronization()` in `e2e/editor.e2e.ts`.
To generate an Android production bundle locally without EAS cloud queues, run `eas build --platform android --profile production --local` which outputs an `.aab` file using `pixelcraft.jks`.
TypeScript path mappings in `tsconfig.json` resolve `@/*` to `./src/*`, mirrored by `babel-plugin-module-resolver` inside `babel.config.js`.
App Store submission rejected with `Asset validation failed: Missing Info.plist key NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription`; resolved by injecting the key via the `ios.infoPlist` field in `app.config.ts`.
To upgrade Expo SDK when native code is modified, run `npx expo install expo@^51.0.0 --fix`, execute `npx expo prebuild --clean`, and then re-run `pod install --project-directory=ios`.
RTK Query endpoints in `src/store/api/paletteApi.ts` use `setupListeners(store.dispatch)` declared in `App.tsx` to automatically refetch community palettes on network reconnect.
Android build failed with `java.lang.NoSuchFieldError: No field mHybridData` under Hermes; fixed by bumping `react-native-reanimated` to `3.10.1` and running `./gradlew clean` in `android/`.
To execute an isolated Detox test against mock data, run `npm run mock:api &` and then execute `npx detox test e2e/auth.e2e.ts -c ios.sim.debug --reuse`.
The app uses Git commit counts (`git rev-list --count HEAD`) to dynamically set `ios.buildNumber` and `android.versionCode` in `app.config.ts`.
Detox failed with `Test Failed: View is not visible: <RCTView testID="layer_delete_btn">`; fixed by applying `pointerEvents="box-none"` to the overlay container in `src/screens/EditorScreen.tsx`.
Canvas undo/redo stacks are managed in `src/store/slices/historySlice.ts` with a hard limit of 50 actions to prevent high memory consumption.
To purge corrupted native and Metro artifacts completely, run `watchman watch-del-all && rm -rf node_modules ios/Pods ios/build android/app/build && npx expo start -c`.
Google Play upload failed with `Google Play requires apps to target API level 34`; resolved by specifying `"targetSdkVersion": 34` under `android.compileSdkVersion` in `app.json`.
Bundle size analysis is executed by running `npx react-native-bundle-visualizer --expo` before tagging release commits.
画板图层的所有核心状态由 `src/store/slices/layerSlice.ts` 管理，所有新图层 ID 必须通过 `nanoid/non-secure` 生成以规避 Hermes 运行时的加密模块异常。
Android 混淆构建后启动崩溃报错 `ClassNotFoundException: com.pixelcraft.store.NativeBridge`，在 `android/app/proguard-rules.pro` 中追加 `-keep class com.pixelcraft.** { *; }` 后解决。
发布 iOS 到 TestFlight 时，先执行 `eas build -p ios --profile production`，构建成功后运行 `eas submit -p ios --latest` 触发 App Store Connect 上传。
Android 端 Detox 测试入口文件位于 `android/app/src/androidTest/java/com/pixelcraft/DetoxTest.java`，必须继承 `Detox` 并配置 `AndroidJUnitRunner`。
iOS 提审因出口合规被拒并提示 `ITMS-90683: Missing Purpose String in Info.plist`，在 `app.config.ts` 的 `ios.config` 中声明 `ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption: false` 修复。
导出画板为 PNG 并存入系统相册时，需通过 `react-native-view-shot` 的 `captureRef(canvasRef, { format: 'png' })` 抓取临时 URI，再调用 `expo-media-library` 的 `createAssetAsync` 保存。
路由参数定义在 `src/types/navigation.ts`，每个页面组件需使用 `NativeStackScreenProps<RootStackParamList, 'Editor'>` 进行强类型注解。
Detox 测试报错 `Cannot find UI element with testID: "palette_color_0"`，排查发现自定义组件外层未透传属性，在 `src/components/ColorSwatch.tsx` 的 `Pressable` 上显式挂载 `testID` 解决。
配置 Android 生产密钥库时，执行 `keytool -genkeypair -v -keystore pixelcraft.jks -alias pixelcraft-key -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000`，随后运行 `eas credentials` 上传该 JKS 文件。
国际化文案存放在 `src/locales/{en,zh}.json`，Redux `settingsSlice.ts` 中仅允许保存语言代码字符串（`'en' | 'zh'`），禁止存储本地化文本内容。
Android 模拟器中 Redux Thunk 接口报错 `TypeError: Network request failed`，原因是模拟器无法直连本机 localhost，将开发端点改为 `http://10.0.2.2:3000` 解决。
本地快速复现生产环境 Android APK 时，运行 `eas build -p android --profile preview --local --output=pixelcraft-preview.apk` 并使用 `adb install -r pixelcraft-preview.apk` 推送至设备。
`assets/icon.png` 必须保持 1024x1024 无透明 Alpha 通道，而 `assets/adaptive-icon.png` 前景主体必须内嵌在中心 66% 安全区域内以适配各厂商遮罩。
Detox 在 iOS 模拟器输入框卡死报错 `Keyboard did not dismiss`，在 `e2e/setup.ts` 中加入 `beforeEach` 钩子调用 `Keyboard.dismiss()` 并在必要步骤执行 `device.reloadReactNative()`。
调试 Redux 数据变更时，在 `src/store/index.ts` 开发环境下挂载 Flipper 插件，随后在终端执行 `npx flipper` 即可实时查看 action payload 与 diff。
EAS Update 机制约定：PR 预览部署执行 `eas update --branch preview`，生产热更发布必须执行 `eas update --branch production --message "<commit-hash>"`。
启动时字体加载白屏报错 `Font.loadAsync failed: source does not exist`，在 `src/hooks/useCachedResources.ts` 中通过 `expo-splash-screen` 保持屏障，在 `finally` 中调用 `SplashScreen.hideAsync()` 解决。
离线运行 Detox 回归用例时，执行 `detox test --configuration ios.sim.release --headless --record-logs all` 并注入 `MOCK_SERVER=true` 环境变量跳过网络依赖。
Google Play 隐私合规要求最小权限原则，`app.config.ts` 中的 `android.permissions` 数组严禁包含未经业务申报的 `READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` 权限。
iOS 编译报错 `The linked library 'libPods-pixelcraft.a' is missing one or more architectures`，在 `ios/Podfile` 的 `post_install` 节点中强制移除 `EXCLUDED_ARCHS[sdk=iphonesimulator*] = arm64` 解决。
Snowflake production profile uses warehouse TIDEWATCH_TRANSFORM_WH, role TRANSFORMER_ROLE, and target database TIDEWATCH_PROD configured in ~/.dbt/profiles.yml.

Airflow DAG parser threw 'AirflowException: DAG file /dags/tidewatch_hourly_buoy.py did not yield any DAGs' because instantiation was inside an 'if __name__ == '__main__':' block; remove the block so the top-level parser registers the DAG object.
To run dbt models with tags and refresh upstream sources in production, execute: dbt run --select +tag:hourly_ocean_metrics --target prod --vars '{"backfill": false}'.
The Great Expectations checkpoint execution wrapper is located at scripts/run_ge_suite.py and requires the environment variable GX_ENVIRONMENT=production.

Pandas 2.2 emitted 'FutureWarning: Series.fillna with 'method' is deprecated and will raise in a future version. Use obj.ffill() instead' in src/parsers/noaa_station.py; replace all .fillna(method='ffill') calls with .ffill().
To re-lock and validate dependencies under Python 3.12 without activating Astronomer, run: uv pip compile pyproject.toml -o requirements.lock --python-version 3.12 && astro dev restart.
Raw NOAA buoy ingest drops unparsed JSON payloads into Snowflake table TIDEWATCH_PROD.RAW.BUOY_TELEMETRY_JSON inside the VARIANT column named payload.

dbt model stg_noaa_water_levels failed with 'SQL compilation error: syntax error line 14 at position 8 unexpected qualify' because QUALIFY was placed before GROUP BY; QUALIFY row_number() over (...) = 1 must appear after GROUP BY and WHERE clauses.

To run a single Great Expectations checkpoint locally while muting Slack notifications, execute: gx checkpoint run buoy_raw_checkpoint --action-list-operator-override-kwargs '{"notify_slack": false}'.
The standard Airflow connection ID for Snowflake tasks is snowflake_tidewatch_conn, configured to authenticate using snowflake_jwt key-pair authentication.

Pip failed on Python 3.12 with 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named distutils' during snowflake-connector-python build; solve by pinning snowflake-connector-python>=3.7.0 and adding setuptools>=69.0.0.
To generate mock NOAA telemetry for local integration tests, execute: python scripts/seed_mock_buoy_data.py --records 5000 --stage-only to push sample Parquet files into s3://tidewatch-dev-landing/.
Incremental dbt models in models/marts/marine/ must specify unique_key=['station_id', 'recorded_at_utc'] and incremental_strategy='merge'.

src/loaders/stream_loader.py raised 'pyarrow.lib.ArrowInvalid: Capacity error: BinaryArray cannot contain more than 2147483646 bytes'; resolved by passing dtype_backend='pyarrow' with chunksize=250_000 during pd.read_csv.
To generate and locally inspect compiled dbt documentation, run: dbt docs generate --profiles-dir ~/.dbt --project-dir ./dbt && dbt docs serve --port 8085.
All HTTP sensor ingestion operators in dags/ingestion/ must declare execution_timeout=timedelta(minutes=15) to prevent hanging tasks on dormant NOAA endpoints.

Great Expectations check failed with 'ValidationFailed: Expectation expect_column_values_to_be_of_type failed for column wind_gust_knots: Expected type FLOAT, found VARCHAR'; fixed by wrapping the column in try_to_double(wind_gust_knots) in models/staging/stg_noaa_wind.sql.
To trigger an Airflow backfill for the ingestion pipeline across a specific past date window, execute: airflow dags backfill -s 2024-01-01 -e 2024-01-07 --reset-dagruns tidewatch_noaa_raw_ingest.
The repo standardizes on uv for virtualenv management, strictly targeting Python 3.12.3 as specified in .python-version.

Snowflake COPY INTO crashed with '100069 (22000): Date 2024-02-29T23:59:60Z is not recognized' due to unhandled leap seconds; sanitized incoming ISO8601 strings to :59 in src/cleaners/timestamps.py before upload.
dbt 模型分层命名规范：models/staging/ 必须使用 stg_ 前缀，models/marts/ 目录下按业务域划分为 ocean/、meteo/ 与 alerts/ 子目录。

Airflow 调度任务报错 'AirflowSensorTimeout: Sensor has timed out; Execution date 2024-04-01T00:00:00+00:00 is not aligned with NOAA station local time'，原因是时区漂移；在 dags/sensors/tide_level_sensor.py 中使用 pendulum.timezone('UTC') 显式对齐时间戳。
手动触发指定潮位站点历史数据重跑的命令为：airflow dags trigger -c '{"station_id": "9414290", "reprocess": true}' tidewatch_manual_backfill。
Great Expectations 配置文件位于 great_expectations/great_expectations.yml，其生成的 Data Docs 静态页面归档至 Snowflake stage @TIDEWATCH_PROD.ANALYTICS.GE_DOCS_STAGE。
dbt 运行大表时抛出 '000627 (57014): Statement reached its statement execution time out limit 3600 seconds'，通过在 dbt_project.yml 中为 models/marts/ 配置 +warehouse: TIDEWATCH_HEAVY_WH 增加计算资源。
在本地针对特定数据源单独执行检验套件时，运行命令：great_expectations suite run --suite-name tide_station_raw_suite --datasource-name snowflake_pipeline。
使用 snowflake.connector.pandas_tools.write_pandas 批量写入数据时，必须显式传入 auto_create_table=False 和 quote_identifiers=False，以兼容 Snowflake 默认的大写表结构。
Python 3.12 触发警告 'DeprecationWarning: datetime.datetime.utcnow() is deprecated and scheduled for removal'，在 src/utils/time_utils.py 中统一替换为 datetime.now(timezone.utc)。
全量刷新并测试单个增量模型的标准命令为：dbt run --select stg_tide_predictions+ --full-refresh --target dev && dbt test --select stg_tide_predictions。
项目自定义 Airflow Operator 存放在 plugins/tidewatch/operators/，引用时统一写为 from tidewatch.operators.noaa_api import NOAADataFetchOperator。
Great Expectations 本地全量加载引发 'MemoryError: Unable to allocate array with shape (12000000, 18)'，修改为使用 GX Fluent API 的 add_snowflake 批处理，将断言计算下推至 Snowflake。
彻底重置并清理本地开发环境残留的 Airflow 容器与卷时，运行命令：astro dev stop && docker compose down -v && docker system prune --volumes -f。
Airflow DAG 根据环境变量 AIRFLOW_VAR_TARGET_ENV 路由 Snowflake 目标数据库，dev 环境对应 TIDEWATCH_DEV，prod 环境对应 TIDEWATCH_PROD。
升级 dbt-core 导致插件报错 'dbt.exceptions.DbtPluginError: Adapter snowflake is not compatible with dbt-core 1.8.0'，解决方案是在 pyproject.toml 中将 dbt-snowflake 显式锁定为 ==1.8.0 并重跑 uv sync。
将指定站点的历史潮位清洗结果导出为 Parquet 文件的 CLI 命令为：python -m src.cli export-station --station-id 8454000 --start-date 2024-01-01 --out data/exports/。
核心编排任务 dags/tidewatch_orchestrator.py 的调度周期设定为 cron: '*/30 * * * *'，并且强制设置 catchup=False。
Pandas 遇到非标准缺失值报 'ArrowTypeError: Could not convert null with type str to double'，在 src/parsers/csv_parser.py 的 pd.read_csv 中加入 na_values=['null', 'N/A', '-999.0'] 解决转换失败。
在本地对单个 DAG 进行静态语法检查与无环测试时，执行命令：pytest tests/dags/test_dag_integrity.py -k test_tidewatch_orchestrator。
Airflow 管道失败告警通过 DAG 的 on_failure_callback 统一转发至 Slack，Webhook 凭证配置在 Airflow Connection 的 slack_alert_webhook 中。
并行 DAG 任务写入同一目标维度表报 '000100 (40001): Transaction deadlock detected'，在 Airflow 中为 models/marts/dim_stations.sql 相关的 Task 配置互斥资源池 snowflake_dim_station_pool。
The workspace layout divides functionality into crates: `crates/kiln-core` for the imaging engine, `crates/kiln-cli` for the command-line entrypoint, and `crates/kiln-simd` for vector acceleration.

Running `cross build --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu` failed with `error: linking with cc failed: exit status: 1` on `libjpeg-turbo-sys`; resolved by setting `RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=-crt-static"` in `Cross.toml`.

To run ARM64 benchmarks locally via QEMU: configure `[target.aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu]` runner in `.cargo/config.toml` as `"qemu-aarch64 -L /usr/aarch64-linux-gnu"` and execute `cargo bench --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --bench filter_bench`.

The CLI binary parses `--threads` (`-t`) to configure `rayon::ThreadPoolBuilder::new().num_threads(...)`, defaulting to physical CPU core count instead of virtual threads to avoid cache thrashing during convolutions.

Compilation error `cannot find function neon_vld1q_u8 in core::arch::aarch64` occurred during SIMD porting; resolved by adding `#[cfg(target_arch = "aarch64")]` and importing from `core::arch::aarch64::*` instead of `core::arch::arm::*`.
Criterion output data is stored in `target/criterion/`, and regression checks require baseline comparisons using `cargo bench -- --save-baseline <name>` and `cargo bench -- --baseline <name>`.

To inspect memory allocations in `kiln-core`: set `#[global_allocator]` to `dhat::Alloc` inside `tests/alloc_check.rs`, execute `cargo test -p kiln-core --test alloc_check --features dhat-heap -- --nocapture`, and inspect `dhat-heap.json` in the DHAT UI.

Runtime panic `misaligned pointer dereference` occurred in `simd_convolve` when casting raw pointers to `float32x4_t`; fixed by allocating buffers using `aligned_vec::AVec` with 64-byte alignment or falling back to `vld1q_f32` unaligned loads.
Targeting `aarch64-unknown-linux-musl` requires vendoring `nasm` for JPEG decoding by specifying `features = ["nasm-static"]` for `mozjpeg-sys` in `crates/kiln-core/Cargo.toml`.

To generate an ARM64 release Debian package: run `cross build --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --release -p kiln-cli` first, then run `cargo deb --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu -p kiln-cli --no-build` to package the pre-compiled binary.

Received `SIGILL: illegal instruction` inside Docker QEMU execution of `kiln-cli`; fixed by configuring `RUSTFLAGS="-C target-cpu=cortex-a53"` instead of `-C target-cpu=native` to prevent generating ARMv8.2-A dotprod instructions on older emulation targets.
The crate `crates/kiln-core` strictly maintains `#![deny(unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn)]` to prevent unsafe raw buffer reads inside SIMD blocks without explicit `unsafe` blocks.

Criterion benchmarks in `benches/resample.rs` must configure `.warm_up_time(Duration::from_millis(500))` and `.measurement_time(Duration::from_secs(3))` to avoid severe thermal throttling on passive ARM development boards.

To generate flamegraphs directly on an ARM Linux target: execute `perf record -F 99 -g target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/kiln-cli resize -i in.png -o out.png`, then pipe through `perf script | stackcollapse-perf.pl | flamegraph.pl > resize.svg`.

Build broke with `could not find native static library jpeg`: resolved by installing `libjpeg62-turbo-dev:arm64` in the build container and exporting `PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/pkgconfig`.
The CI workflow uses `cross` version `0.2.5` defined in `.github/workflows/arm-release.yml` with custom `Cross.toml` referencing `ghcr.io/cross-rs/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu:edge`.
To verify parity between scalar and NEON color transforms: run `cargo test -p kiln-simd --test parity -- --nocapture`, which asserts delta epsilon `< 1e-4` across 1,000,000 randomized RGBA values.

Encountered `error[E0599]: no method named finish found for struct Criterion` after updating Criterion to `0.5`; resolved by removing manual `.finish()` calls since lifecycle management is now handled inside `criterion_main!`.
Dimensions in `kiln-core::image::ImageBuffer` are capped at `16384 x 16384` pixels to prevent 32-bit integer wrapping during raw buffer byte stride computations.

Clippy failed on pointer casts with `clippy::cast_ptr_alignment`; resolved by replacing direct pointer conversions `ptr as *const u128` with `std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping` or the `bytemuck::cast_slice` helper.
工作区根目录的 `Cargo.toml` 统一管理依赖版本，子 crate 引入通用库时必须声明为 `image.workspace = true` 与 `rayon.workspace = true`。
交叉编译时提示 `fatal error: zlib.h: No such file or directory`；通过在 `Cross.toml` 中添加构建前钩子安装 `libz-dev:arm64` 依赖解决。
在 ARM 开发板上收集基准性能数据：运行 `cargo bench --bench blur_bench -- --output-format bencher | tee blur_raw.txt`，随后运行 `python3 scripts/parse_bench.py blur_raw.txt` 导出对比表格。
`kiln-cli` 基于 `clap` v4 的 `derive` 模式定义命令行，图片滤镜选项通过 `#[arg(value_enum, default_value_t = FilterType::Lanczos3)]` 暴露。
双三次插值常量数组抛出 `error[E0080]: evaluation of constant value failed ... attempt to compute 0usize - 1usize`；修复方式是将边界计算中的无符号减法改为有符号 `isize` 差值计算。
查看 ARM NEON 自动向量化汇编输出：运行 `cargo rustc -p kiln-simd --lib --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu -- --emit asm`，并在 `target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/deps/*.s` 中检索 `fmla` 与 `ld4r` 指令。
`kiln-core` 的色彩空间转换模块统一遵循 BT.709 规范，RGB 转灰度权重常量配置为 `R: 0.2126`、`G: 0.7152`、`B: 0.0722`。

执行 `cross test --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf` 抛出 `qemu: uncaught target signal 4 (Illegal instruction)`；原因系 QEMU 模拟器未启用对应 CPU 特性，在 `Cross.toml` 中配置 `environment = { QEMU_CPU = "cortex-a9" }` 后通过测试。
新增图像滤镜算子流程：先在 `kiln-core/src/filter/` 实现 `FilterOp` trait 标量逻辑并附带单元测试，随后在 `kiln-simd` 中编写 aarch64 NEON 特化实现，最后在 `benches/filter_bench.rs` 注册评估用例。
针对嵌入式 ARM 发布二进制时，`Cargo.toml` 的 `[profile.release]` 必须配置 `lto = "fat"`、`codegen-units = 1` 与 `panic = "abort"` 以缩减体积并内联跨 crate 的 SIMD 辅助函数。
Lanczos 测试在 aarch64 出现 `assertion failed: (a - b).abs() < 1e-5` 失败；原因系 FMA 指令导致精度微小浮动，将单精度测试误差容限放宽至 `1e-4` 并对边缘像素补齐舍入逻辑。
`crates/kiln-core` 使用 `object_pool` crate 维护临时像素复用缓冲池，避免在流式处理大量切片小图时频繁向系统申请堆内存导致碎片化。
本地调试交叉编译的 ARM64 core dump：执行 `gdb-multiarch target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/debug/kiln-cli core`，在 GDB 内配置 `set architecture aarch64` 与 `set solib-search-path /usr/aarch64-linux-gnu/lib` 查看崩溃回溯。
执行基准测试遇到 `error: no benches available to run`；原因是新增基准文件未在 `Cargo.toml` 显式声明 `[[bench]]` 配置，添加对应条目并配置 `harness = false` 后恢复。
`kiln-cli` 支持标准 UNIX 管道流处理图片，当文件路径指定为 `-` 时，输入解码器与输出编码器自动重定向至标准输入输出流。
重置 Criterion 性能基线：删除本地 `target/criterion/` 缓存目录，执行 `cargo bench -p kiln-core --bench resize -- --save-baseline baseline_v1` 记录基准指标。
在对图像多行进行并行卷积时报 `error[E0277]: the trait bound rayon::iter::ParallelIterator is not satisfied`；修复方式是在源文件头部显式引入 `use rayon::prelude::*;`。
项目官方维护两个 Linux ARM 目标三元组：主要平台为 64 位的 `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`，次要轻量级平台为 32 位的 `armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf`。
为 `cross` 容器配置私有镜像源：在项目根目录创建 `.cross/Cargo.toml` 映射源地址，并在 `Cross.toml` 的 `[target.<target>]` 下配置卷挂载宿主机的 `~/.cargo/credentials.toml`。
交叉构建因依赖项报错 `failed to run custom build command for openssl-sys`；通过为网络导出特性开启 `features = ["vendored"]` 启用静态编译 OpenSSL，避免寻找目标平台的系统 libssl。
The project uses Go 1.23.1 with sqlc v1.27.0 configured for postgresql and pgx/v5 in internal/database/sqlc.yaml; run 'sqlc generate' from repository root after editing schema or queries.

Encountered 'rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = "transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 10.0.3.45:9090: connect: connection refused"' when calling auth-service from ECS; fix was adding grpc.WithKeepaliveParams with a 30s ping time in internal/auth/client.go to prevent AWS NLB idle connection drops.

To add an authenticated route in chi, declare the handler in internal/handler/, attach it inside r.Route("/v1", func(r chi.Router) { r.Use(authMiddleware.RequireSession); r.Get("/resource", h.GetResource) }) in router.go, and pass incoming bearer tokens to the gRPC auth context.

Redis keys must strictly follow the format 'harbor:{env}:{entity}:{id}' (e.g., 'harbor:prod:user:usr_98a7cf'), and keys must be defined as constants in internal/cache/keys.go with explicit TTL durations.

A nil pointer crash 'panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference' occurred in querier.GetWorkspace because pgtype.Text.Valid was false; always inspect .Valid before reading the .String field on nullable sqlc columns.

To regenerate gRPC client stubs for the auth service, execute 'buf generate proto/auth/v1 --template proto/buf.gen.yaml', which outputs generated PB structs and client interfaces to internal/gen/auth/v1/.

Global Chi router middlewares in internal/server/router.go must always execute in strict sequence: middleware.RequestID, middleware.RealIP, middleware.Logger, middleware.Recoverer, and middleware.Timeout(30 * time.Second).

Handler returned an empty string from chi.URLParam(r, "id") because the route parameter was registered as '/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}'; parameter keys passed to chi.URLParam must exactly match the braced placeholder in the route pattern.

To handle graceful shutdown in ECS tasks, listen for syscall.SIGTERM in cmd/api/main.go, invoke httpServer.Shutdown(ctx) with a 20-second timeout, flush and close the Redis connection pool, and close the auth service gRPC client before process termination.

The ECS task definition harbor-api-prod specifies 1 vCPU and 2048 MB memory, requiring GOMEMLIMIT=1800MiB and GOMAXPROCS=1 in container environment variables to avoid Fargate cgroup out-of-memory kills.

Encountered 'json: unsupported type: map[interface {}]interface {}' when unmarshaling Redis cached objects; fix was explicitly serializing domain structs with json.Marshal before rdb.Set and deserializing into concrete struct pointers in internal/cache/store.go.

To run integration tests locally, spin up ephemeral PostgreSQL and Redis instances via testcontainers-go using testutil.NewTestSuite(t), apply migrations from /migrations using goose.Up, and pass generated DSNs to repository constructors.

When calling the auth service gRPC endpoint, the HTTP Authorization header must be propagated downstream using metadata.AppendToOutgoingContext(ctx, "authorization", authHeader) inside internal/auth/interceptor.go.

AWS ECS task health check failed with 'Container.Healthcheck: curl: command not found' because the image is based on gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12; resolved by switching ECS health check to native ALB HTTP target checks pointing to /healthz.

To benchmark database queries under load, run 'go test -bench=BenchmarkListTenants -benchmem -cpuprofile=cpu.pprof ./internal/database/...' and evaluate lock contentions via 'go tool pprof -http=:8081 cpu.pprof'.
Structured logs are produced using Go 1.23 log/slog with a JSON handler, and every log record must contain the 'request_id' and 'trace_id' attributes extracted from the chi request context.

Batch inserts failed under load with 'pq: deadlock detected' on table 'audit_logs'; fixed by sorting the input slice by entity_id ascending prior to invoking querier.CreateAuditLogsBatch in internal/database/audit.go.

To rotate Redis credentials with zero downtime, store the secret in AWS Secrets Manager, deploy a new ECS task definition referencing the secret via secrets manager ARN in valueFrom, and wait for AWS target group draining to retire old tasks.
Production builds require 'CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o harbor-api cmd/api/main.go' to ensure complete static linking without glibc dependencies on distroless ECS containers.

Experienced memory bloat during CSV export requests because sub-slices preserved references to 30MB backing buffers; fixed by using Go 1.23 slices.Clone to detach sub-slices before caching or sending downstream.
路由挂载规范要求所有业务接口挂载于 '/api/v1' 路径组，根路由仅暴露用于 ALB 存活探针的 '/healthz' 以及校验 Redis 和 DB 连通性的 '/ready'。
运行 'sqlc generate' 提示错误 'column "org_id" does not exist'，排查原因为本地新写了迁移文件但未合并至 'internal/database/schema.sql'；sqlc 仅基于静态 schema.sql 文件生成类型，不读取动态迁移记录。
本地启动完整依赖栈需执行 'make dev-env'，该命令会通过 docker-compose.dev.yml 启动 PostgreSQL 16、Redis 7 和 Auth Mock 容器，并自动运行 'goose -dir migrations postgres "$DB_DSN" up' 完成初始化。
调用 internal auth 服务的 gRPC 客户端必须配置 grpc.WithDefaultServiceConfig 设置指数退避重试，限制最多重试 3 次，且仅对 codes.Unavailable 与 codes.ResourceExhausted 状态码生效。
Chi 启动抛出 'panic: chi: route "/users/{id}" conflicts with existing route in router'，原因是静态子路由 '/users/export' 被注册在通配符路由 '/users/{id}' 之后；调整注册顺序使静态路由优先声明即可修复。
缓解热点缓存击穿的步骤：在 internal/service/user.go 中引入 singleflight.Group，将 Redis 查空后的 DB 查询与回写缓存逻辑封装在 sfGroup.Do(key, fn) 内，并针对空结果写入带 30 秒 TTL 的占位值。
单元测试强制规范：业务逻辑层单元测试必须针对 internal/database/querier.go 中生成的 sqlc 'Querier' 接口使用 mockgen 打桩，除集成测试外禁止连接真实数据库。
ECS 部署失败并抛出 'ResourceInitializationError: unable to pull secrets or registry auth'，排查原因是 ECS Task Execution Role 缺少对 AWS Secrets Manager 所使用的自定义 KMS Key 的 'kms:Decrypt' 权限。
创建数据库迁移流程：执行 'goose -dir migrations create <migration_name> sql' 编写 DDL 脚本，执行 'goose -dir migrations postgres "$DATABASE_URL" up' 验证迁移，随后将完整 DDL 同步到 schema.sql 并执行 'sqlc generate'。
生产环境中 go-redis/v9 客户端必须配置 PoolSize: 50、MinIdleConns: 10 与 ConnMaxIdleTime: 5 * time.Minute，防止突发流量导致短连接激增打满 ECS 容器的 Ephemeral Port。
异步写审计日志报错 'rpc error: code = Canceled desc = context canceled'，原因是 HTTP handler 直接将 r.Context() 传入后台 goroutine；必须使用 Go 1.23 context.WithoutCancel(r.Context()) 派生出非取消 context。
规范化统一 API 错误输出：在 internal/response/error.go 中编写 RenderError 函数，通过 errors.As 提取自定义 AppError，输出固定 JSON 结构 '{"code": "...", "message": "...", "request_id": "..."}' 并绑定对应的 HTTP 状态码。
部署在 AWS ECS VPC 内的 harbor-api 调用内部 auth 服务时，必须使用 AWS Cloud Map 注入的 Private DNS 地址（auth.internal:9090），以走内网传输并规避跨可用区 NAT 网关流量费。
sqlc 生成的 UUID 字段经 json.Marshal 序列化后异常变为 '{"Bytes":[...],"Valid":true}'；需要在 sqlc.yaml 的 overrides 规则中显式将 'uuid' 数据库类型映射为 'github.com/google/uuid'。
配置端到端链路追踪穿透：在 Chi 中挂载 otelchi.Middleware("harbor-api") 捕获 W3C Traceparent 标头，并在初始化 auth gRPC 连接时配置 otelgrpc.NewClientHandler() 自动透传 Trace Context。
Git 提交强制校验：在 .githooks/pre-commit 脚本中配置了 'golangci-lint run' 以及 'git diff --exit-code internal/database'，以防止开发者修改 SQL 后遗漏执行 sqlc generate 直接提交代码。
批量写入缓存未生效但无错误日志，排查发现在使用 rdb.Pipeline() 时只调用了 pipe.Set 和 pipe.Expire，遗漏了最后的 '_, err := pipe.Exec(ctx)' 调用；补齐 Exec 并检查聚合错误后恢复。
排查线上 Redis 内存溢出流程：登录 AWS ElastiCache 控制台查看 'EngineCPUUtilization' 与 'DatabaseMemoryUsagePercentage'，利用 AWS ECS Exec 进入 harbor-api 容器并执行 'redis-cli --bigkeys' 定位大 key。
在批处理扫描场景下，代码库采用 Go 1.23 的 iter.Seq 机制实现流式查询，如 internal/database/scanner.go 中的 ScanTenants(ctx) iter.Seq2[*Tenant, error]，防止大数据集全量加载导致 OOM。
自定义中间件捕获 Panic 恢复后，客户端收到 200 OK 且响应体截断；原因是先调用了 w.Write() 产生隐式 200，随后才触发 panic；必须确保 middleware.Recoverer 包裹在最外层且在写入前设置 w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)。

In Next.js 15, dynamic route params are asynchronous; dynamic MDX docs at 'app/[lang]/[...slug]/page.tsx' must type props as '{ params: Promise<{ lang: 'zh' | 'en'; slug: string[] }> }' and await 'params' before accessing slug segments.
项目使用 '@tailwindcss/typography' 插件渲染 MDX 内容，暗色模式下的文章正文样式必须指定 'prose dark:prose-invert' 类名。

Running 'npm run build' failed with 'Error: Route "/[lang]/[...slug]" used params.lang. "params" should be awaited before using its properties.'; fixed by awaiting 'params' in 'generateMetadata' inside 'app/[lang]/[...slug]/page.tsx'.
运行 Algolia 索引脚本时抛出 'AlgoliaSearchError: Record is too large (max: 10000 bytes)'；修复方案是在 'scripts/index-algolia.ts' 中按 heading 节点拆分 MDX 片段并剔除原始 AST 代码树后再上传。

To manually reindex Algolia records for staging, run 'dotenv -e .env.preview -- tsx scripts/index-algolia.ts --locale all --dry-run' to inspect chunk counts, then omit '--dry-run' to sync to 'lumen_docs_preview_en' and 'lumen_docs_preview_zh'.
新增 MDX 自定义组件时，在 'components/mdx/' 下编写组件并在 'components/mdx/index.tsx' 的 'useMDXComponents' 字典中注册，最后在 'types/mdx.d.ts' 中补充 JSX 属性声明。
The repository enforces Node.js '>=20.9.0' via '.nvmrc' and 'package.json' engines field to satisfy Next.js 15 baseline runtime requirements.
多语言字典维护在 'locales/en.json' 和 'locales/zh.json'，在 Server Components 中必须通过 'lib/i18n/get-dictionary.ts' 中的 'getDictionary(lang)' 静态异步读取。

Vercel preview sub-paths failed with 'NEXT_NOT_FOUND' because 'middleware.ts' intercepted internal static assets; resolved by adding '/((?!api|_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|.*\..*).*)' to 'config.matcher'.
本地启动 'next dev --turbopack' 时遇到 'Module not found: Can't resolve 'rehype-pretty-code''；原因是该包为 pure ESM 导出，在 'next.config.mjs' 中配置 'transpilePackages: ['rehype-pretty-code', 'shiki']' 解决。

To add a new bilingual documentation section, create matching MDX files at 'content/docs/en/<section>/<file>.mdx' and 'content/docs/zh/<section>/<file>.mdx', then register the route entry in 'content/nav.config.json'.
调试 Vercel 预览环境的 Algolia 检索时，运行 'vercel env pull .env.preview.local --environment=preview' 拉取配置，随后执行 'NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_ENV=preview npm run dev' 即可连入隔离测试索引。
Algolia uses two separate indices: 'lumen_docs_en' and 'lumen_docs_zh', conditionally resolved in 'components/search/SearchModal.tsx' using the first segment of 'usePathname()'.
所有 MDX 文档的 Frontmatter 均由 'lib/mdx/schema.ts' 中的 Zod schema 统一校验，'title'、'description' 和 'order' 属于强制必填字段。

Builds on Vercel crashed with 'Error: Invariant: duplicate key: /zh/getting-started' caused by identical slugs across two MDX files; solved by adding an automated unique slug validation step in 'lib/mdx/get-docs.ts'.
中文搜索分词失效导致无法匹配长文本；排查发现 Algolia 索引缺少 CJK 设置，在 'scripts/index-algolia.ts' 的 'setSettings' 中注入 'indexLanguages: ['zh', 'en']' 和 'queryLanguages: ['zh', 'en']' 后修复。

To verify bilingual SEO alternates, execute 'curl -s http://localhost:3000/en/docs/quickstart | grep -A 5 '<link rel="alternate"'' and ensure 'hreflang="zh"' resolves to the absolute canonical URL containing '/zh/'.
批量升级 unified 插件链时，先执行 'pnpm update remark-gfm rehype-slug'，再运行 'pnpm test:mdx' 执行快照测试以校验 AST 是否存在未闭合 JSX 标签或死链。
Code syntax highlighting runs through 'rehype-pretty-code' with dual Shiki themes: 'github-light' and 'github-dark', toggled via CSS variable classes rather than runtime re-renders.
生产环境 Algolia 索引同步禁止本地随意调用，仅能由推送至 'main' 分支的 GitHub Actions 工作流（'.github/workflows/algolia-sync.yml'）使用 Admin API Key 触发。

Running 'next build' triggered 'Error: Cannot find module 'canvas'' during dynamic OG image creation; fixed by changing 'app/[lang]/api/og/route.tsx' to use 'export const runtime = 'edge'' with standard Satori-compatible elements.
引入 '@docsearch/react' 时控制台报 'ReferenceError: window is not defined'；原因是组件在服务端预渲染，需在 'components/search/AlgoliaSearch.tsx' 中配合 'dynamic(() => import(...), { ssr: false })' 动态导入。
To debug edge routing redirects locally, run 'vercel dev --listen 3000' after ensuring '.vercel/.project.json' is linked to 'lumen-docs' to emulate exact Vercel Edge Middleware runtime behavior.
如需向 MDX 提供编译期全局变量，可在 'lib/mdx/compile.ts' 内部调用 'compileMDX' 时，向 'scope' 选项注入全局常量字典（如当前仓库 release version）。
Root layout in 'app/[lang]/layout.tsx' must export 'generateStaticParams()' returning '[{ lang: 'en' }, { lang: 'zh' }]' to pre-render layout HTML shells for both supported locales.
MDX 文档严禁直接书写原生 '' 标签，必须统一使用封装的 'components/mdx/MDXImage.tsx' 以启用 'next/image' 的 WebP/AVIF 自动压缩并防止 CLS 抖动。

Preview deployments hung indefinitely during pre-rendering because Algolia attempted to write to production without valid credentials; resolved by skipping the sync hook in 'next.config.mjs' if 'process.env.VERCEL_ENV === 'preview''.
运行 'pnpm lint' 时提示 'ESLint: Parsing error: The keyword 'export' is reserved'；排查为 ESLint 9 扁平配置缺失 MDX 处理器，在 'eslint.config.mjs' 中加入 'eslint-plugin-mdx' 规则块后修复。
To inspect the parsed MDAST of a failing document, run 'npx tsx scripts/inspect-ast.ts content/docs/en/troubleshooting.mdx' to output formatted syntax nodes before HTML transformation.
修复跨页面坏链时，先执行 'pnpm run check:links' 运行 'scripts/check-broken-links.ts'，检查工具会同时校验中英文 MDX 文档内的相对锚点与外链并输出行号。
MDX table-of-contents extraction happens at build time in 'lib/mdx/toc.ts' using 'unist-util-visit' to scan heading depths 2 and 3 alongside their generated slug IDs.
Tailwind 配置中的容器预设在 'tailwind.config.ts' 中扩展了 'max-w-8xl' (90rem)，用于 'app/[lang]/[...slug]/layout.tsx' 中适配 2K 宽屏文档阅读布局。

Switching between Chinese and English pages triggered hydration error 'Text content did not match server-rendered HTML'; fixed by adding 'suppressHydrationWarning' to '<html>' in 'app/[lang]/layout.tsx' for theme attributes.
误在 'next.config.mjs' 中开启了 'output: 'export''，导致带动态国际化重定向的 'middleware.ts' 构建报错；移除该静态导出项后 Edge 中间件恢复正常。
To perform a clean build after changing MDX remark plugins or cache structure, run 'rm -rf .next content/.cache && pnpm dev' to purge stale cached compilation nodes.
发版打标时，先在 'content/versions.json' 增补新版本号，再运行 'pnpm run generate:sitemap' 更新静态 sitemap.xml 里的中英文多语言 alternate 节点。
Search modal uses '@algolia/client-search' v5 API, requiring initialization via 'liteClient(appId, searchKey)' instead of the deprecated 'algoliasearch()' constructor.
'middleware.ts' 使用 '@formatjs/intl-localematcher' 配合 'negotiator' 解析 HTTP 请求头的 'Accept-Language'，若无匹配则硬编码回退至 'en' 语言环境。

Algolia search hit anchors failed to navigate because 'rehype-slug' stripped special characters while indexing preserved them; resolved by sharing the identical 'slugify' helper between 'rehype-slug' and 'scripts/index-algolia.ts'.
合并 PR 时 Vercel Preview 部署报错 'Missing env var NEXT_PUBLIC_ALGOLIA_SEARCH_KEY'；原因是变量仅设置在了 Production 环境，在 Vercel Settings -> Environment Variables 勾选 Preview 后解决。
Prefers pnpm over npm or yarn for package management across all JavaScript and TypeScript projects.
Always formats commit messages according to the Conventional Commits specification using lowercase types (e.g., feat:, fix:, refactor:).
Develops on macOS Apple Silicon using Neovim within tmux as the primary editing environment.
Prefers explicit return type annotations on all exported TypeScript functions rather than relying on type inference.
Uses pytest with pytest-mock and fixture-based dependency injection instead of standard library unittest in Python.
Prefers concise, direct explanations without conversational fluff, pleasantries, or apologies.
Avoids barrel files (index.ts re-exports) in frontend codebases to prevent circular dependencies and bundle bloat.
Uses mise (formerly rtx) instead of asdf or nvm to manage language runtimes and CLI versions.
Favors Tailwind CSS utility classes over CSS Modules, styled-components, or vanilla CSS in React applications.
Requires all Git commits to be cryptographically signed with a hardware YubiKey.
Prefers pure functions and immutable data structures over object-oriented class hierarchies where practical.
Requests that terminal commands and CLI flags be shown in their explicit long form (e.g., --output instead of -o) in snippets.
Runs Zsh with the Starship prompt and heavily relies on the GitHub CLI (gh) for PR and issue workflows.
Spins up local infrastructure dependencies like PostgreSQL and Redis via Docker Compose rather than native Homebrew services.
Values comprehensive unit tests targeting boundary conditions over reaching arbitrary 100% code coverage metrics.
技术文档与代码注释习惯使用中文编写，但代码标识符与变量命名必须使用精准的英文。
Python 项目统一采用 Ruff 作为代码检查与格式化工具，单行最大字符长度固定为 100。
创建 Git 分支时严格遵循特定命名规范，如 username/feat-feature-name 或 username/fix-issue-number。
Go 项目中强制开启 golangci-lint 进行静态检查，且禁止使用 init() 函数进行隐式状态初始化。
编写 GitHub Actions 工作流时，要求第三方 Action 必须引用完整的 commit SHA 而非浮动 tag。
本地终端使用 Alacritty，编程字体偏好带有连字特性的 JetBrains Mono。
讨论复杂业务流或架构设计时，偏好使用 Mermaid 流程图或时序图辅助解释。
排查 Bug 时希望先获得根本原因（Root Cause）分析，再查看最小修改代码片段，而非整段重贴文件。
Node.js 后端开发倾向于使用轻量高性能的 Fastify 框架，避免使用 NestJS 或传统 Express。
关系型数据库表与字段统一使用蛇形命名法（snake_case），并且必须包含 created_at 与 updated_at 时间戳。
严禁在提交的代码中残留无用的 import 引用或用于临时调试的 console.log/print 语句。
代码缩进在 JavaScript、TypeScript、JSON 和 YAML 等文件中统一保持 2 个空格。
本地原型开发时优先选用 SQLite（配合 WAL 模式）或 Postgres，坚决避免使用 MongoDB。
生成数据库迁移脚本后，要求先展示生成的原生 SQL 预览，确认无破坏性修改（destructive changes）后再执行。
每个项目根目录下必须维护完善的 .env.example 文件，清晰罗列所有环境变量及其默认示例值。

Update for project orderflow: Setting org.gradle.java.home in gradle.properties has been removed; Java 21 builds are now configured using Gradle toolchains with java.toolchain.languageVersion = JavaLanguageVersion.of(21) in build.gradle.

Updated the sequence configuration in project orderflow: to optimize batch insert performance, altered the PostgreSQL sequence increment to 50 and updated @SequenceGenerator(name="order_seq", allocationSize=50) in Order.java.
生产数据库与 Kafka 的密码凭证管理方案已变更：已弃用 HashiCorp Vault 与 External Secrets Operator (ESO)，现统一由 AWS Secrets Manager 托管，并通过 Kubernetes Secrets Store CSI Driver 动态注入。
国际化文案存放路径已变更为 `src/i18n/locales/{en,zh,ja}.json`，Redux `settingsSlice.ts` 中保存的语言代码类型更新为 `'en' | 'zh-CN' | 'ja'`，仍严格禁止在 Redux 中存储本地化文本内容。

Injecting NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription directly via the `ios.infoPlist` field in `app.config.ts` has been replaced; the permission is now configured via the `expo-media-library` config plugin inside the `plugins` array of `app.config.ts`.
更新：调色板组件重构，原 `src/components/ColorSwatch.tsx` 已迁移至 `src/features/palette/components/ColorItem.tsx`，Detox 测试的 `testID`（`palette_color_${index}`）现改为挂载在最外层的 `Animated.View` 上，而非原先的 `Pressable`。
All HTTP sensor ingestion operators in dags/ingestion/ must now declare execution_timeout=timedelta(minutes=5) instead of 15 minutes following updated NOAA endpoint SLA limits.
Airflow 管道失败告警已更新：告警接收端由 Slack 切换为飞书（Lark），Webhook 凭证现已配置在 Airflow Connection 的 lark_alert_webhook 中，替代了原有的 slack_alert_webhook。
Great Expectations 生成的 Data Docs 静态页面归档目标已更新，现已变更为 Snowflake stage @TIDEWATCH_PROD.ANALYTICS.GE_DOCS_STAGE_V2（原 @TIDEWATCH_PROD.ANALYTICS.GE_DOCS_STAGE 已废弃）。
Lanczos 测试在 aarch64 平台的单精度误差容限已更新：原定的 `1e-4` 容限无法完全覆盖新版编译器自动向量化差异，现已将其统一调整为 `5e-4` 并弃用边缘像素补齐舍入逻辑。

Update for project kilnrs: Direct imports from `core::arch::aarch64::*` for NEON intrinsics have been replaced; all AArch64 SIMD operations must now be imported from `kilnrs_simd::neon::*` to ensure uniform cross-platform fallback handling.

本地调试交叉编译的 ARM64 core dump 流程已更新：不再使用 gdb-multiarch，改为执行 `aarch64-linux-gnu-gdb target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/debug/kiln-cli core`，且 GDB 内的共享库搜索路径变更为 `set solib-search-path /opt/sysroots/aarch64/lib`。

Update for project harbor-api: The sqlc configuration has been moved from internal/database/sqlc.yaml to the repository root at sqlc.yaml, and developers must now run 'make sqlc' instead of running 'sqlc generate' directly.

Replaced Go 1.23 slices.Clone in CSV export requests with streaming directly to an io.Writer using a sync.Pool buffer pool, after detaching slices via cloning still caused excessive GC churn under peak load.
部署在 AWS ECS VPC 内的 harbor-api 调用内部 auth 服务的配置已更新：现已弃用 Cloud Map Private DNS，全面迁移至 ECS Service Connect，服务调用地址变更为 auth-service.internal:8080（旧地址 auth.internal:9090 已停用）。
'middleware.ts' 已更新：不再使用 '@formatjs/intl-localematcher' 和 'negotiator'，改用 'next-intl/middleware' 进行语言环境路由解析，且请求头无匹配时的默认回退语言环境已由 'en' 更改为 'zh-CN'。
后续由于 'eslint-plugin-mdx' 与 ESLint 9 扁平配置存在兼容性冲突，现已在 'eslint.config.mjs' 中将其替换为 '@mdx-js/eslint-plugin' 来处理 MDX 文件。
修复跨页面坏链的流程已更新：原 'pnpm run check:links'（运行 'scripts/check-broken-links.ts'）已废弃，现改为执行 'pnpm run lint:links' 运行 'scripts/lint-mdx-links.ts' 来校验中英文 MDX 文档内的相对锚点与外链并输出行号。
